ai_summary: Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals, through its wholly-owned subsidiary, is acquiring Oriflame India's manufacturing business, including two plants and a warehouse, for a cash consideration of INR 56 Crore. This strategic move marks Akums' entry into color cosmetics and expands its presence in the fast-growing skincare and wellness product markets, enhancing its manufacturing capabilities. A key detail is that Akums is not acquiring the Oriflame brand or marketing rights, necessitating its own branding and distribution strategy for the new product lines.
